video_title: 2026-27 Training Camp Media Availability 🎙️ | Labaron Philon Jr. | 10.02.26

quotes.speaker: Labaron Philon Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Labaron Philon Jr. on adapting to the 76ers' system
quotes.excerpt: playing for coach's system is very helpful, all the things that we did back then is translating now
quotes.quote: It has been good, being able to compete against all the guys on the team and see how quick the game goes and the things you have to learn on the fly. I feel like I have been doing pretty good. Playing for coach's system is very helpful, all the things that we did back then is translating now. I have been telling guys where to go and being able to be a vocal leader for the guys that got me in the group and trying to be a vocal leader, a younger leader to everybody around me. It has been going great and I have been seeing great strides.
quotes.social_post: Labaron Philon Jr. says he is embracing a vocal leadership role early in his rookie training camp, noting that he has been telling teammates where to go and seeing great strides in his development.

quotes.speaker: Labaron Philon Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Labaron Philon Jr. on learning from LeBron James's longevity
quotes.excerpt: asking questions about LeBron's longevity, he has been playing the game ever since I was born
quotes.quote: From JB, he made a couple fadeaway tough shots on me and I am just like, how are you focused enough to see the rim throughout the contest and the bodies coming in the paint? Outside of that, really just asking questions about LeBron's longevity, he has been playing the game ever since I was born. So just trying to see how he takes care of his body, getting in the trainer room. I try to get in the trainer room as much as I can early in the morning and after practice trying to get extra work.
quotes.social_post: Rookie Labaron Philon Jr. is picking the brain of veteran teammates to learn about longevity, saying he is trying to see how they take care of their bodies and get into the trainer room as much as he can.

quotes.speaker: Labaron Philon Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Labaron Philon Jr. on mastering NBA offensive schemes
quotes.excerpt: it helps a lot knowing the terms and knowing the NBA style offense
quotes.quote: It helps a lot knowing the terms and knowing the NBA style offense. That is why I have been being able to tell guys where they need to go and learn plays on the fly just because this is the kind of offense we were running back then. It is easy to me now to remember things and have that move on the fly. As a rookie, I feel like that is an important skill, not messing up and not messing things over more than once. If I can see it the first time, I can do it all the time.
quotes.social_post: Labaron Philon Jr. credits his familiarity with the offensive schemes for his quick adjustment to the NBA, stating that being able to learn plays on the fly is an important skill for a rookie.

quotes.speaker: Labaron Philon Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Labaron Philon Jr. on the responsibilities of an NBA point guard
quotes.excerpt: you have to be able to move the ball, play unselfish, you have to have that unselfish part
quotes.quote: You have to be able to move the ball, play unselfish, you have to have that unselfish part and you have to be able to know where everybody is supposed to be at just because somebody might mess up or somebody might be in the wrong spot. You have to learn how to see that immediately and learn how to correct it on the fly. Being a point guard at this level is definitely a great thing just because you have all the guys, the point guard area is an important part of the team and you have to be vocal.
quotes.social_post: Labaron Philon Jr. on the responsibilities of an NBA point guard: You have to be able to move the ball, play unselfish, and know where everybody is supposed to be at all times.

quotes.speaker: Labaron Philon Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Labaron Philon Jr. on receiving mentorship from veterans
quotes.excerpt: the one-on-one talks during practice, when I am making great plays he will pull me to the side
quotes.quote: The one-on-one talks during practice, when I am making great plays he will pull me to the side and just tell me the concepts and the reads that if this is not open or I do not have a shot, these are the reads we want to make. It has been good, he has been helping me out pretty well and ever since I got on the floor and stepped into this building he has been helping me. That is a great thing and all the other guys too, just being vocal, being helpful and that takes a lot from everybody.
quotes.social_post: Labaron Philon Jr. says he is benefiting from one-on-one mentorship during practice, with veterans pulling him aside to explain concepts and reads when he makes plays.

quotes.speaker: Labaron Philon Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Labaron Philon Jr. on the development of the team's big men
quotes.excerpt: I would say my bigs, Ariel, he is a great screener, Bona and B, all those guys
quotes.quote: I would say my bigs, Ariel, he is a great screener, Bona and B, all those guys. I would say the bigs have been doing a great job. Being able to see Joel out there fully practicing is great, he is cooking. Being able to see Ariel get in the pocket for the short roll has been good, so just seeing those guys compete at a high level. Being a point guard and I feel like a point guard and a big is close to connect, so I would say trying to connect with them has been very important.
quotes.social_post: Labaron Philon Jr. says it is great to see Joel Embiid fully practicing, adding that the star big man is cooking and putting in big effort on the defensive end.

quotes.speaker: Labaron Philon Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Labaron Philon Jr. on Joel Embiid's two-way impact
quotes.excerpt: defensively he has been really good, two-on-ones, three-on-ones, he has been doing his job stopping guys
quotes.quote: Defensively he has been really good, two-on-ones, three-on-ones, he has been doing his job stopping guys from scoring and that is kind of hard when you have three guys coming at you. So he has been putting big effort in on the defensive end and offensively I do not think I have ever seen a big that can score, pass and do everything at once. So really just seeing him do that has been really joyful to see just because he has a smile on his face and he is making plays.
quotes.social_post: Labaron Philon Jr. on Joel Embiid: I do not think I have ever seen a big that can score, pass and do everything at once. It has been really joyful to see him make plays.

quotes.speaker: Labaron Philon Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Labaron Philon Jr. on his approach to passing and decision-making
quotes.excerpt: I always been a great passer, having the right guys and the right plays and the right mindset
quotes.quote: I always been a great passer, having the right guys and the right plays and the right mindset. I feel like first you have to be unselfish, second you have to have guys that want to move on the floor and then third is just coming down to making the best decision. I feel like for me the best decision is making the easiest play. Right now I do not really need no showtime or flashy plays, the position I am in right now is just making the right play every time.
quotes.social_post: Labaron Philon Jr. on his passing philosophy as a rookie: Right now I do not really need no showtime or flashy plays, the position I am in right now is just making the right play every time.
